name: Godparents
overview: Scripture emphasizes the responsibility of nurturing and teaching children in the fear of the Lord, as seen in Deuteronomy 6:7 and Proverbs 22:6, which instruct caregivers to diligently train children in godly ways. The example of Mordecai raising Esther (Esther 2:7) illustrates the biblical principle of providing spiritual and practical care to those without parental guidance. Honoring parents (Exodus 20:12) and gently leading the young (Isaiah 40:11) reflect God's design for godly mentorship and guardianship, foundational to the role of godparents within the Christian community.
